_about: Written by hand. translations: English for reviews that came with no translation, a half-finished one, or a machine one we rewrote (keyed by the review id on Airbnb, Booking.com or Vrbo); it is shown in front, and the guest's own words stay on the page as the original. The Vrbo reviews themselves are fetched by fetch-vrbo-reviews.py on the Mac mini.

text.title: Spectacular terrace
text.good: Spectacular terrace with a sea view, a very spacious apartment with every comfort. The garage is very handy too.
text.bad: If I had to find a flaw, perhaps the bathroom: the shower is almost impossible to set between hot and cold, and it is a bit worn overall, from the door itself to the shower tray.

text.good: Excellent location, lots of space. A wonderful neighbourhood, full of places for lunch and dinner, and a supermarket too. A short hop from Funchal and the centre. The garage is great to use as well. Very kind owners, ready to help with anything.
text.bad: It would be nice to have the flat cleaned at least once every 7 days.

text.title: All excellent
text.good: Very nice and good-value accommodation, everything we needed. Many thanks to Nathalia, Hugo and Arthur. We felt very much at home and would gladly come again.

Communication and the key handover were very good. Good location, close to a bus stop. A space in the garage for the car. Shops nearby. The flat is well equipped and very clean. The bed was comfortable.
text.bad: The flat is very noisy, depending on who is in the flats around it. The flat is a little dated overall.

text.good: We had 10 wonderful days and were happy with the apartment. The location is very good. Communication and check-in were perfect. Thank you, Natalia!

text.title: A place you have to discover
text.good: Madeira is, without any doubt, a place to discover. Natalia and Hugo's apartment is ideally placed, close to restaurants, shops, bus stops and the famous Lido promenade. The double terrace is more than pleasant, with a view of the ocean, and our hosts told us what to see and what to taste: all the must-dos. I recommend it without any hesitation!
